releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.9.1 (Clean Glyph Rendering & Word Replacement Fix)
changelog:
✨ Clean Typography & Foolproof Word Replacement:
• Zero Ink-Blob Text Rendering: Switched from FILL_AND_STROKE expansion to pure Paint.Style.FILL vector contours. Eliminates synthetic bold distortion and filled glyph counters in 'A', 'e', 'k', rendering razor-sharp original fonts.
• Resilient Word Fragment Merging: OCR automatically merges adjacent fragmented elements (e.g. 'V' + 'EER' = 'VEER') on the same line so words are never split into isolated letters.
• Smart Leftover Character Detection: Intelligent assistant chip alerts you if an accidental leading letter remains (e.g. 'VAnkit') and provides a 1-tap fix to clean text ('Ankit').
• Strict User Bold Choice: Typography engine strictly honors user bold preferences and avoids forcing false bold on regular camera photo text.
• Accurate Upper-Case Font Scaling: Calibrated cap-height scaling for clean, true-to-life text replacement without vertical drift or horizontal squishing.
